'''Rebek''' is a [[Domani]] lieutenant.

== Activities ==
[[Durnham]] recruits Rebek, a man who onced served in the King's Guard, from the beggars. He is appointed as lieutenant.{{ref/book|13|25}}

== Trivia ==
* Rebek is named for Rebecca Joseph, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
